results.message: Supplied configuration contains an active zero-cost or threshold-based free-shipping path.
actions: Review the identified rate or promotion under K-DEC-001.

results.message: Machine Product assignment or quotation enforcement evidence is missing or unverified.
actions: Collect complete Product-to-profile assignments and supported quotation-routing evidence.

results.message: Grafton pickup configuration or location evidence is missing.
actions: Collect location, pickup-setting, and readiness evidence.

results.message: An international shipping zone is configured, but the supplied Market evidence does not confirm active international checkout availability.
actions: Verify Market activation and actual checkout availability before determining whether K-DEC-004 is contradicted.

results.message: One or more supplied shippable Products have missing or zero shipping weight.
actions: Obtain authoritative packed weights through Epic E/F ownership.

results.message: No authoritative validity interval exists; no universal expiration period is inferred.
actions: Have the source owner establish any applicable validity rule.
